svg.title: CNC operator — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as cnc operator, wearing coveralls. Visible work cue: A CNC control panel displays a stepped tool path beside a separate helical milling cutter. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Appearance: curly hair, a rounded face.
